title: End-to-end MVP acceptance hardening

context.summary: Add demo seed and MVP acceptance scripts that exercise the planned API, CLI, MCP and Hermes flows.
context.background: TASK-26 made Docker Compose runnable. The final MVP task needs a repeatable acceptance path for project/session/message/document/memory/context flows across interfaces.

in: Add demo seed fixtures and script for local MVP credentials/input data.
Add an MVP acceptance script with live mode for API/CLI/MCP/Hermes flows.
Add a dry-run acceptance mode that validates scenario coverage in environments without Docker.
Cover document upload, job polling, source-backed memory, context build, CLI, MCP and Hermes adapter calls.
Document how to run live acceptance against Docker Compose.
out: Guarantee live Docker execution in environments without Docker.
Add a UI dashboard or browser flow.

acceptance_criteria: A demo seed script can create a deterministic local MVP bearer token.
A demo document fixture is present for upload/indexing acceptance.
The MVP acceptance script defines API, CLI, MCP and Hermes phases.
Live mode can create project, peers, session/messages, upload a document, poll jobs/status, remember source-backed memory and build context.
Dry-run mode passes in this repository without Docker and verifies scenario coverage.
Docs explain Docker/live prerequisites and commands.

manual_checks: Confirm live E2E command is documented.
Confirm dry-run clearly states it did not hit live Docker services.
Confirm Docker unavailability in this environment is recorded.

risks: Docker is not available in the current execution environment, so live E2E cannot be run here.
Live acceptance requires an explicit demo seed because token management API endpoints remain post-MVP.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
